decks.notes: The key concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with a focus on flying, lifelink, and token generation. By utilizing cards like Bishop of Wings, Resplendent Angel, and Righteous Valkyrie, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures that can gain life and create valuable tokens. Additionally, cards like Collected Company and Kayla's Reconstruction provide additional ways to access key creatures and create an aggressive board state. Overall, the deck is designed to apply early pressure and maintain board advantage through a combination of synergy and efficient creature spells.

This deck focuses on fast-paced aggression, utilizing low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The main strategy is to maintain a high level of pressure on the opponent, using efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger along with spells like Titan's Strength and Ancestral Anger to deal damage quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds a versatile and powerful option to the deck. With a strong mana base and a focus on speed and efficiency, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on using sacrificing creatures and stealing opponent's creatures to gain advantage on the battlefield. By utilizing cards like Witch's Oven, Mayhem Devil, and Cauldron Familiar, the deck can create a loop of sacrificing and dealing damage to the opponent. The addition of Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute allows for even more flexibility and disruption in the opponent's strategy. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and resource management.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponents' spells, wiping the board with Supreme Verdict, and generating card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for additional value. The mana base includes utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Ardenvale, while also running a suite of counterspells like Dovin's Veto. The deck aims to out-value opponents and control the game until it can secure a win condition with cards like The Wandering Emperor or March of Otherworldly Light.

The deck focuses on using sacrifice effects and token generation to quickly overwhelm the opponent with damage. By utilizing cards like Witch's Oven, Cauldron Familiar, and Mayhem Devil, the deck aims to control the board while steadily dealing damage. Scavenger's Talent and Deadly Dispute provide additional ways to generate value from sacrificed creatures, while Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds another layer of consistency and power to the deck.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value and dealing direct damage to the opponent. By combining cards like Witch's Oven, Cauldron Familiar, and Mayhem Devil, the deck builds a board presence while punishing the opponent for every sacrifice made. The inclusion of removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn help control the board and clear the way for aggressive plays. The deck utilizes a combination of creature sacrifice, direct damage, and removal to pressure the opponent and secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck utilizes the Companion Jegantha for additional mana ramp and consistency. With a mix of creature buffs, direct damage spells, and haste creatures, this deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently, putting pressure on the opponent from the start. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive playstyle, with a focus on black and red dual lands to ensure the deck can cast its spells on curve.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent through efficient creatures and removal spells, aiming to disrupt their game plan while dealing consistent damage. The inclusion of cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Graveyard Trespasser, and Archfiend of the Dross help maintain aggression, while cards like Fatal Push, Go for the Throat, and Thoughtseize provide crucial removal and disruption. The deck also includes cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional value and flexibility in different game situations.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of cards like Magma Opus, Creative Outburst, and Leyline Binding to control the board and generate value through card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Zagoth Triome and Otawara, Soaring City helps to ensure proper mana fixing, allowing for smooth gameplay and consistency. The presence of companions like Keruga, the Macrosage adds an extra layer of strategy by providing additional card draw and a larger hand size. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and creatures while maintaining board control.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester, Voldaren Thrillseeker, and Voldaren Epicure. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. Additionally, the inclusion of Mutavault and Flamecache Gecko provides flexibility and reach in dealing damage to the opponent. The deck's overall strategy revolves around maintaining a fast and consistent offensive tempo to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on building a fast and aggressive board presence, utilizing low-cost creatures and combat tricks to quickly overrun the opponent. The deck includes a companion creature, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional support and versatility. With a mix of protection spells, efficient creatures, and combat enhancers, this deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the battlefield to secure a swift victory.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to use a combination of counterspells, board wipes, and card draw to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By managing threats efficiently and slowing down the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to establish board control and win the game through card advantage and incremental advantage. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion also adds additional value and flexibility to the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck focuses on disruption and resource management to dominate the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of aggressive creatures, disruptive spells, and tempo plays to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By using cards like Mausoleum Wanderer, Spell Queller, and Supreme Phantom to control the board and apply pressure, along with support from cards like Skyclave Apparition and No More Lies, the deck aims to maintain a strong presence on the battlefield while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. This Azorius Tempo/Spirit Aggro deck focuses on efficient plays and tempo advantage to secure victory against opponents in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures and pump effects such as Righteous Valkyrie and Resplendent Angel. Collected Company allows for card advantage and tempo plays, while Bishop of Wings and Giada, Font of Hope provide life gain to survive longer against opposing aggressive strategies. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive curve while also ensuring consistency in color requirements. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed, power, and resilience.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and the synergy between Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Mayhem Devil to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. It also includes cards like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn for removal and disruption. The deck aims to set up a combo with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Ygra, Eater of All to win the game in a single explosive turn. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the cards in the deck.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Bishop of Wings, Skyclave Apparition, and Righteous Valkyrie. By ramping with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck can quickly deploy threats and maintain pressure on the opponent. Collected Company allows for explosive turns by putting multiple creatures onto the battlefield at once. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and powerful angels like Resplendent Angel, while also gaining life to outlast aggro decks.
